title: BitTitan MigrationWiz — M365 → Google Migration Execution
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Execute M365→Google migrations with BitTitan MigrationWiz
problem: Many enterprises run their M365→Google move on BitTitan MigrationWiz — a SaaS migration platform for mail, documents, and collaboration. This solution is the MigrationWiz execution playbook: set up the project and endpoints (M365 + Google), deploy the Device Management Agent where needed, configure mail/document/Teams-to-Chat projects, run pre-stage and delta passes with throttling, and validate — so migrations run predictably at enterprise scale.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the MigrationWiz model (projects, endpoints, agents, pre-stage/delta passes), where it fits vs native tools, and the wave approach.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (MigrationWiz account + licensing, M365 + Google admin access/app registrations, endpoints, pilot scope).

Implementation Guide — create project + endpoints, configure mail/document/Teams projects, run pre-stage + delta passes with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; MigrationWiz console internals + licensing deferred to BitTitan docs, procedure and sequencing given.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (pilot passes complete, delta clean, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for pre-stage/delta cutover sequencing.
short: Execute M365→Google with BitTitan MigrationWiz — projects + endpoints, mail/document/Teams migrations, pre-stage and delta passes with throttling, and validation — so migrations run predictably at scale. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
